paragraphs.text:
You get specific directions to the Fuzira Marketplace. Two 
alternate names for the marketplace run through your mind: 
“The place where anything can be lost or gained,” and, “the place 
where souls are bartered.” You idly thumb through the volume. 
You think you would like to go to Egypt. Go to 74. 
(85)
